name: GozNym Network
description: GozNym was an international cybercrime network that stole approximately $100 million from over 41,000 victims by combining the Gozi banking malware with the Nymaim dropper. A coordinated international operation in 2019 dismantled the network, with the US charging 10 members across 6 countries. GozNym operated as a structured criminal enterprise with specialized roles — malware developers, spammers, money mule recruiters, and cash-out specialists.
